title: Readable Under Pressure
author: Agile Lens
source: Original text created for the Understudy sample pack, October 28, 2026. Not a quotation or a device-readiness claim.

entries.text: Original rehearsal text. Pause and resume at your own pace.
Start slowly. Pause. Resume. Return to the beginning, then find this sentence again.
Distinguish these characters: capital I, lowercase l, and the number 1. Read zero, capital O, eight, capital B, five, and capital S.
Read these numbers: 14:50, 15:10, 2026, 0.05, 1,250, and negative forty-two.
Long words follow: internationalization, counterrevolutionaries, electroencephalographically, pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis.
Now read a deliberately unbroken token: antidisestablishmentarianismantidisestablishmentarianismantidisestablishmentarianism.
Quotation marks matter: “Hold,” she said. Apostrophes matter: we’re ready; don’t rush. An em dash can hold a thought—then release it.

Unicode check: café, naïve, résumé, and a smiling face 😀. A line break follows.
This sentence begins on a new line.
Look away for one breath. Find the cyan words. Check whether the last sentence is still visible when the script finishes.
